caption:
3 tips for a handwriting font that looks like you ✍️

1️⃣ Use a black felt-tip or gel pen, not a pencil or ballpoint
2️⃣ Write each character in the middle of its box, without touching the edges
3️⃣ Photograph the sheet from straight above in even light

Then turn it into a .ttf font at font.315tools.com.
